onboarding_2.title: Create your wallet

onboarding_2.description: Create and reconnect to a digital wallet using new identification methods:
onboarding_2.icloud_note: Identification is done automatically via the access key linked to your iCloud account.
onboarding_2.warning: Do not allow anyone to access your phone and your funds.

onboarding_3.confirm_checkboxes: Check all boxes to confirm you understand the importance of access keys.
onboarding_3.checkbox_1_ios: On your phone, go to “Settings › Your account › iCloud” and enable “Passwords and keychain” (not 1Password) to activate access keys.
onboarding_3.checkbox_1_android: Once the wallet is created, identification methods (fingerprints, facial recognition, or PIN code) will be synchronized with your Google account.
onboarding_3.checkbox_2: Access keys allow you to recover the wallet in the future if your device is lost or replaced.
onboarding_3.checkbox_3: Important: if your access key is deleted (and you haven't saved it otherwise), you will lose access to the wallet and funds.

onboarding_4.option_recover_wallet: I could still recover my wallet
onboarding_4.option_lose_access: I would no longer be able to connect to my wallet and would lose access to my funds.
